title: Rav Shimi bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: And in Pesachim 59b: "Rav Shaman bar Abba said to Rav Papa, 'According to you, who said...' etc." Now it is known that Rav Shaman bar Abba was in Eretz Israel, a student of Rabbi Yochanan; how, then, could he be in the time of Rav Papa? In truth, one must say, following the reading in Dikdukei Soferim, Rav Shimi bar Abba; and therefore Yuchasin was correct in citing Rav Shimi bar Abba as being in the time of Rav Papa.
Perhaps Nazir 50b should likewise read Rav Shimi bar Abba speaking to Rav Papa, where our text reads Rav Shimi bar Ada.

notes.text: Shaman, Shimi and Ada are kept as Hyman’s reported forms and proposed corrections. His identification of Shimi as Rav Papa’s contemporary is his chronological argument.

The inspected Nedarim 36a names Shimi bar Abba, while the inspected Pesachim 59b retains Shaman bar Abba addressing Rav Papa. Hyman’s chronological challenge and proposed Dikdukei Soferim repair, and his tentative Nazir correction, remain his argument.
